review_candidates.title: Desktop Support Officer - Site Lead (Education)
review_candidates.description: Join Centorrino Technologies: Innovate, Grow, and Thrive with Us! At Centorrino Technologies (CT), we’re more than just tech—we’re a community that goes beyond expectations. We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work in 2025 and Top 5 Inspiring Workplaces for 2026, with an outstanding eNPS score of 68. And we’re not stopping there. We're on a mission to redefine the customer experience, and we need a passionate Desktop Support Officer - Site Lead to join our team in Kingswood. Requirements What you'll do: Ensure the smooth day-to-day operations of customer environments. Coordinate and deliver high-quality onsite technical support to customers across various locations, ensuring timely resolution of issues. Oversee the diagnosis and resolution of hardware and software issues across a range of devices, including Macs, PCs, tablets, and voice platforms. Take ownership of day-to-day technology issues and liaise with external third-party organisations. Supervise and mentor a team of Desktop Support Officers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing work environment. Facilitate training for team members to enhance their technical skills and ensure they stay up to date with emerging technologies. Build strong relationships with clients, providing friendly and knowledgeable assistance while maintaining a positive customer experience. Gather customer feedback to inform service improvements and maintain high levels of satisfaction. Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and security protocols in all support activities. Maintain accurate records of support activities, including incident tracking and resolutions, and provide regular reports on team performance and customer feedback. Identify and implement process improvements to streamline operations. Collaborate with other departments to deliver the highest quality solutions. What You'll Bring A passion for providing exceptional customer service, demonstrated through helping others resolve technical issues with computers and other technology devices, whether in a professional environment or assisting family and friends. A strong interest in technology and a desire to ensure systems and devices are functioning effectively. Willingness to learn new technologies and concepts to confidently liaise with staff and external vendors. Strong communication skills when troubleshooting technical issues, with the ability to remain calm, explain problems clearly, and provide guidance on preventative measures. A positive, proactive attitude with a proven track record of helping others resolve technical challenges. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. Flexibility and adaptability when handling unusual situations, including adjusting work schedules or working additional hours when required to support business needs. Benefits Why You'll Love Working Here: Our Company Is More Than Just a Workplace, It's a Hub Of Inspiration And Creativity Where Employees Love To Work! Here's Why Extensive training and development opportunities that enable continual growth as part of your career planning. Extensive discounts and benefits to maximise your money. A choice of your IT equipment to maximise your success and access to cost-price tech for your personal needs. Fun team events to celebrate achievements and connect with colleagues outside work as part of our engaging culture. CT celebrates diversity and enables every voice to be heard as we drive to create the world we want. Apply today and be part of a team that values innovation, inclusivity, variety and diverse backgrounds. Note: A valid Vulnerable People / Working with Children Check (WWCC) and Police Check are required.

review_candidates.title: Web Designer
review_candidates.description: About the job Join Our Dynamic Team as a Website Designer Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide! Monthly Salary: up to 40,000 EGP depending on experience and overall assessment Working hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 am to 7:00 pm Sydney, Australia Time (4:00 am to 12:00pm Egypt Standard Time) WHO WE ARE WE ARE MEDIBOOST!!! Our Vision & Mission: We help unleash the potential & vision of dentists, doctors, and specialists. We do so by helping them generate hyper growth in their practices through world-class, effective digital marketing campaigns. Mediboost is a patient growth marketing agency owned and founded in Australia with a track record of helping dental and medical practices scale quickly. Overview We are seeking a creative, highly detail-oriented Website Designer with strong graphic design skills to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong eye for design, branding, layout, and user experience who can translate ideas and briefs into visually compelling, conversion-focused websites as well as marketing assets such as digital ads, banners, social media graphics, and other creative collateral. Attention to detail is extremely important in this role. We are looking for a designer who takes pride not only in how their work looks, but also in how their design files are structured, organised, named, and prepared for collaboration and handover. What You Will Do Design engaging, fully custom, responsive website layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Create high-quality graphics for websites, digital advertising campaigns, banners, social media, and other marketing channels. Translate briefs, brand guidelines, and marketing objectives into polished, conversion-focused designs. Collaborate closely with marketing and development teams to maintain brand consistency across digital platforms. Adapt and customize existing templates to meet client requirements while maintaining strong user experience and conversion principles. Prepare professional website mockups, design concepts, and style guides for internal and client approval. Maintain clean, well-organized Figma files , including logical page structures, frames, components, layers, and assets. Follow clear and consistent Figma layer and component naming conventions so files can be easily understood and used by developers and other designers. Correctly organize and manage logos, brand assets, typography, colors, icons, imagery, and reusable design components . Prepare designs and assets for smooth developer handover. Review your own work carefully for spacing, alignment, typography, consistency, image quality, responsive behavior, branding, and other visual details before submission. Ensure all design output is high-quality, brand-aligned, accurate, and delivered on time. Stay current with design trends, tools, UX/UI best practices, and digital marketing design standards. What We Require Minimum 2–3 years of professional experience in website design and graphic design. Strong proficiency in Figma Strong proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Canva . A strong portfolio demonstrating both website design and graphic design work . Good understanding of responsive design, user-centered design, and mobile-first principles. Strong understanding of typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, color, branding, and layout. Ability to follow existing brand guidelines while maintaining visual consistency. Exceptional attention to detail — this is a critical requirement for the role. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment. Ability to receive feedback, make revisions efficiently, and maintain quality across multiple rounds of changes. Preferred Skills (Nice to Have) Experience with WordPress and common page builders such as Elementor, Divi, or similar. If you're primarily a designer but are willing to learn these tools, we'd still love to hear from you. Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS for minor website adjustments. Familiarity with SEO-friendly web design practices . Experience designing landing pages with a focus on lead generation and conversions. Experience creating additional marketing collateral such as ebooks, brochures, presentations, lead magnets, or downloadable guides . Experience working with developers and preparing organised design files for development handover. Beyond technical ability, we are looking for someone who is meticulous about the small details . Your Figma files should be just as professional behind the scenes as the finished design is visually. Layers should be organized and named correctly, logos and brand assets should be handled consistently, spacing and alignment should be intentional, and files should be easy for another designer or developer to pick up and understand. If you notice when something is a few pixels out of alignment, when typography is inconsistent, or when a layer called 'Rectangle 247 Copy 19' really needs a proper name, you'll probably fit in well here.

review_candidates.title: Wireless Network R&D / Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a Wireless Network R&D / Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and improve mobile core network software for Private Mobile Networks. The successful candidate will contribute to 3GPP-compliant mobile core functions, translating telecom specifications into maintainable, reliable, and production-ready software. This role combines hands-on software engineering, network protocol research, cloud-based test environment development, interoperability testing, fault analysis, and technical documentation. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES You will support R&D and software development for mobile core network products, with responsibilities spanning software design, protocol implementation, cloud-based testing, quality improvement, and technical documentation. Mobile Core Software Design & Development Design and implement mobile core network functions using Go, with opportunities to apply Rust where suitable. Research 3GPP specifications and translate relevant requirements into software design, implementation, and test requirements. Develop maintainable, reliable, and operable software components for Private Mobile Network products. Protocol & Network Engineering Work with mobile core protocols and interfaces such as S1AP, PFCP, GTP, Diameter, RTP, and SIP. Apply Linux and IP networking knowledge to support network software development, integration, and troubleshooting. Analyze network behavior using logs, packet captures, and tools such as Wireshark. Testing, Quality & Interoperability Perform unit testing, integration testing, interoperability testing, and load testing. Build cloud-based test environments on GCP and conduct validation under realistic operating conditions. Identify, analyze, and resolve defects through systematic fault investigation and quality improvement activities. Cloud-Native & DevOps Engineering Use Docker and related virtualization technologies to support development and test environments. Apply Git-based team development practices, including code reviews and design reviews. Contribute to cloud-native development practices, with opportunities to work with Kubernetes and scalable deployment environments. Documentation & Team Collaboration Write clear technical documentation covering design decisions, software behavior, test results, and operational considerations. Collaborate with engineers, researchers, product stakeholders, and partner teams to deliver high-quality network software. Communicate technical findings clearly through logical problem analysis and structured reporting. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Experience: Experience developing commercial software. Implementation experience using the Go programming language. Basic knowledge of Linux and IP networking. Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as Docker. Knowledge of cloud computing and cloud-based development or testing environments. Team development experience using Git. Strong logical problem analysis, technical communication, and collaboration skills. TECHNICAL SKILLS Programming & Software Engineering Go, Rust, commercial software development, maintainable code design, unit testing, code reviews, and design reviews. Mobile Core & Telecom Protocols 3GPP specifications, EPC, IMS, 5GC, S1AP, PFCP, GTP, Diameter, RTP, SIP, and protocol-oriented software requirements. Cloud & Infrastructure Linux, IP networking, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, virtualization technologies, cloud computing, and cloud-native development environments. Testing & Fault Analysis Integration testing, interoperability testing, load testing, logs, packet captures, Wireshark, defect analysis, and quality improvement. Development Practices Git-based team development, technical documentation, structured problem solving, communication, and collaboration across engineering teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Development experience with Rust. Experience with EPC, IMS, or 5GC. Knowledge of mobile core protocols such as S1AP, PFCP, GTP, Diameter, RTP, and SIP. Design and implementation experience referencing 3GPP specifications. Fault analysis experience using Wireshark. Experience with Kubernetes. Cloud-native development experience. EXPECTED OUTCOMES Within 2 months: understand the development environment and product architecture. Within 6 months: independently develop assigned features and evaluate existing deliverables. Within 12 months: lead quality improvements as the owner of key features. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Strong software engineering fundamentals and interest in wireless network technologies. Ability to read specifications, reason logically, and translate requirements into robust implementation. Hands-on mindset for debugging, packet-level analysis, interoperability testing, and quality improvement. Clear communication skills for technical documentation, design discussion, and team collaboration. Motivation to contribute to reliable Private Mobile Network products and next-generation wireless solutions.
